title: platform-standup-2026-03-27
content:
Platform Engineering Standup - 2026-03-27
Attendees: Ava Chen (owner), Ravi Patel, Maya Thompson, Luca Moretti, on-call: Sara Kim (SRE)
Duration: 30m

Summary: Quick weekly sync focusing on control plane rollout, routing policy updates, auth/token rotation, and quota enforcement changes. Main topics: a small regression in quota meter after the 3/25 deploy, routing rule cleanup for canary traffic, and progress on the auth service refactor.

1) Control Plane
- Status: Canary rollout of control-plane v2.1 continuing (canary at 12% cluster traffic). No customer-facing errors reported.
- Work in progress: migrations for the model-version table to support multi-arch metadata (PR #412). Migration plan reviewed in PLAT-842.
- Observability: added ephemeral metrics for commit-to-deploy latency; dashboard updated but still missing some labels for region. Action: Ravi to add region labels to the metric exporter by EOD 2026-03-29.
- Blocker: one schema migration edge-case found when a model metadata record contains legacy nulls; caused a retry storm in canary nodes. Temporary mitigation applied (feature-flagged skips). Long-term: data backfill script. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2026-03-30.

2) Routing
- Status: Smart routing v0.9 in staging. New policy engine supports weighted fallbacks based on latency SLOs.
- Incident review: yesterday we observed a small spike of 5xxs for lower-priority routes when a GPU pool garbage collection overlapped with routing refresh. Root cause: routing refresh interval collided with pool scaling job.
- Action items: Luca to add jitter to scaling job start times and make routing refresh tolerant to transient pool states. Jira: PLAT-857. ETA: 2026-03-29.
- Notes: We will pause aggressive routing refreshes during Dedicated burst windows. Ops to confirm schedule.

3) Auth & Tokens
- Status: Auth service refactor (split token validation from token issuance) is in code review. Major benefit: cut validation latency by ~8% in local tests.
- Security: planned rotation of signing keys next week (2026-04-02). We will run blue/green rollout for validators.
- Action: Ava to draft a runbook for key rotation and backwards compat layer; share with security by 2026-03-30.
- Blocker: one client library uses an older token introspection endpoint; need to coordinate with SDK team for a patch. Notify SDK lead.

4) Quotas & Metering
- Issue: After 3/25 quota service deploy there was an undercount for a subset of streaming sessions leading to mismatched billing estimates for ~0.8% of requests. Root cause: race condition in session close path.
- Mitigation: rolled back the problematic commit in quota-service and re-enabled consistent close semantics.
- Action: add a deterministic end-of-stream ack and unit test covering concurrent close. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2026-03-31.
- Follow-up: finance notified; customer success on standby for any billing inquiries.

5) Reliability & SRE Notes
- On-call Sara reported increased memory pressure on a small number of control plane replicas during heavy model catalog syncs; temporary scale-up performed.
- Action: add backpressure on catalog sync and split heavy syncs into chunked jobs. Owner: Sara + Ravi. ETA: 2026-04-01.

6) Security & Compliance
- Quick check: encryption-in-transit audit ongoing; no blockers. Key rotation plan to be reviewed with security.

7) Action Items (summary)
- Maya: data backfill script for model metadata nulls (ETA 2026-03-30) [PLAT-842].
- Ravi: add region labels to metric exporter (ETA 2026-03-29).
- Luca: add jitter to scaling jobs and make routing refresh tolerant (ETA 2026-03-29) [PLAT-857].
- Ava: draft key rotation runbook and share with security (ETA 2026-03-30).
- Maya: deterministic end-of-stream ack + tests for quota service (ETA 2026-03-31).
- Sara + Ravi: implement chunked catalog sync with backpressure (ETA 2026-04-01).

8) Risks / Notes for leadership
- If the control-plane migration issue takes longer than expected it could delay full rollout to Dedicated clusters; contingency is to extend canary and increase monitoring.
- Quota undercount incident was small in user impact but highlights a need for stronger concurrency unit tests before quota-service deploys.

Next standup: 2026-03-30 (weekly).

Misc notes to self: remember to add the new metrics to the billing dashboard and loop in finance on 3/31 post-resolution.
